description: Find the exact moment the sun is highest for any date, longitude and timezone — with the equation of time included.

faqs.a: Solar noon is when the sun crosses your meridian — its highest point. It rarely matches 12:00 because of your longitude within the timezone and Earth's elliptical orbit.
The equation of time corrects for Earth's elliptical orbit and axial tilt — it swings about ±16 minutes through the year and is built into the calculation.
faqs.q: What is the equation of time?

faqs.a: Use a maps app or search 'my coordinates' — any decimal longitude between −180 and 180 works.
faqs.q: How do I find my longitude?

howto: Press Calculate for your solar noon time.
title: Solar Noon Calculator
